title: Counter loop execution span
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $\Gamma$ be a symbol type, and let $S$ be a state type. Let $H$ be a machine with $k+1$ work tapes and counter-loop states, let $z$ be a configuration on input $x$, let $t$ and $width$ be natural numbers, let $cp$ be an integer, and let $R$ be a predicate on the head positions of the first $k$ work tapes. Require that at every time $u<t$, the state reached from $z$ after $u$ steps is neither done nor escape; at every time $u\le t$, the added tape's head position lies in the integer interval from $cp-1$ to $cp+width$, inclusive, and the first $k$ work-tape head positions satisfy $R$.
hypotheses_covered: A symbol type $\Gamma$ and state type $S$
A machine $H$ with $k+1$ work tapes and counter-loop states
An input list $x$ and configuration $z$ on $x$
A predicate $R$ on functions from the first $k$ tape indices to integers
